svg.desc: Snapshot for anhnam26. 6 public repositories, 9 stars on owned non-fork repositories. Calendar 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-13. Updated 14 Oct 2026 (UTC+7). Red and blue teams play three first-to-three matches beneath the calendar at normal running speed, with a central scoreboard and fixed 3–2 results.

svg.title: Pixel Sports Club - red versus blue
svg.desc: Four distinct pixel cartoon athletes play a repeatable football, basketball and volleyball loop at normal running speed. Each match ends when a team reaches three points. Blue wins football 3-2, red wins basketball 3-2, blue wins volleyball 3-2. Red steals and scores in the third basketball play. The ball rises, spins, glows and morphs as each court transforms. Football and basketball restart with the conceding team; the volleyball point winner serves behind the end line.
